evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies outbound message queuing and bounds checks in src/net.cpp and src/net.h.
rationale: Prevents crashes and buffer overruns by validating outbound message sizes in CConnman. Commit 4b10305dee notes that without bounds checks on message types, 'V1 aborts on a longer type, while V2 can overwrite the first payload byte or write past its encoding buffer.' Hardening outbound serialization against oversized internal or RPC-generated payloads fixes a concrete transport failure mode.
